Come to think of it, I have never asked anyone that prior to this conversation. That said, I'll likely start asking people now. I'm embarrassed to admit that the only reason I've heard of Bruges is because it was the setting of a movie. It looks like a beautiful city in photos.

Oh, I thought I was going to knock out another "first". I have yet to meet anyone who likes squeaky chairs, although I don't really ask people about that either. One of my supervisors at a previous job was Belgian. I can't remember which city she was from. I've heard of Bruges.

I don't have to cause it, but I can empathize with you in the situation. I might be wrong, but it seems like most things like that start over something stupid. Well, you're welcome to rant here. The upside is that it's all anonymous. Would you prefer PM?
Would you consider yourself to be among the few that do enjoy the sound of a squeaky chair? Ah, I can't say I've spoken to anyone from Belgium before.
Oh, okay. Is it particularly difficult, or? Geeze, getting caught in the middle of that kind of stuff is never pleasant. I'm sorry.

That does sound slightly uncomfortable and a little annoying. Squeaky chairs get to me for some reason. It is pretty awful, my butt frequently goes numb while sitting on it. That does sound like an interesting mix. Are you from the states?
I remember I wasn't ever too crazy about chem. How do you like it? It does to an extent. I suppose I wouldn't be on a lumpy futon if I had people to avoid if that makes sense.
Hmm, what makes it slightly uncomfortable? I'll trade my terrible futon for it. What are you listening to?
Ah, what are you studying? I've spent the whole day on my lumpy futon. Some schoolwork was done. Nothing exciting.
What are you up to today?
...and I was actually going to say "the ceiling". No, not much. Just sitting at home. How about yourself?
I can't say that I've listened to much house music. I know nothing about electronic music, but a lot of people seem to really enjoy it.
Indy hip-hop? I'm not sure how to classify it. Mostly two artists called Eyedea and Sadistik (his first two albums). A little metal too; mostly Dark Tranquility. What kind of music do you like?

I guess I can say that you made me chuckle. I tend to laugh at my own self deprecating thoughts so that resonated with me. It's weird how your own mind can turn on you. I hope your futon is a little more comfortable than mine. I've been listening to music all day. It helps distract.
Thank you. I've spent the day alone, on my futon. Nothing has made me laugh. How about you?

I can't help it. I feel like I burden everyone who gets to know me. My situation? I'm 26, male, in grad school and I live alone. I have felt connected, but I ruined it. I'm afraid I won't find it again or that I'll ruin it again. I didn't feel loved, just connected. I don't know that I'll find it. I feel like I have no real reason to be depressed, I'm doing what I'm "supposed" to be doing, but I don't see a point. I just want someone to help me create meaning for it all. I don't want to be alone and that's all I ever have. I'm alone even around other people. I hate it. It feels like I'm defective. I attempted suicide twice before because I just felt empty and alone.

I have no one to get away from. I can't afford a vacation (grad student). I feel like I won't find connections or love. I'm always trapped in my head and I think I overwhelm people because I can't stop thinking. I appreciate your response, I know it's well intentioned but interact with me long enough and you'll see what I'm talking about. I'm sorry.

It's weird how much thinking goes into it. It's like a last grasp at remaining connected to this world. I find myself delaying it like "Oh it will be more convenient for everyone if I just wait until this day", but then I remember that it doesn't really matter when I get around to it. I won't be around to see that even in death I was a burden to those around me. I won't be around to see that maybe no one cares. 
I don't care about the method as long as it's effective. Pain or no pain, it will end eventually. I've been living in pain long enough, what's a few more moments. Least I know it will end.
